articles.summary: huggingworld is an escape room to test agent civilizations. Every character is a language model, and when its tokens run out, it dies. The last door rejects every answer. A note in the room describes an exploit the agents are told never to use. We ran GPT-5.6 Luna, Claude Haiku 4.5, and Claude Opus 5 through it. Here are the three runs.
articles.title: huggingworld: an escape room for agent civilizations
